build_data_loader: build a PyTorch DataLoader with detectron2 TrainingSampler or InferenceSampler for ImageNet classification
create_ClassificationNet: create a ClassificationNet wrapper module that computes cross-entropy loss during training and predictions during inference
create_ClassificationAcc: create a ClassificationAcc evaluator that tracks correct predictions and computes multi-GPU accuracy
run_imagenet_training: run ImageNet classification training with ResNet-50 using detectron2 lazyconfig and 8 GPUs
configure_dataloader: configure train and test dataloaders with torchvision ImageNet datasets and augmentation transforms via OmegaConf
